STIX Two Math and STIX Two Text, Fontsource 5.3.0.
Source: https://github.com/stipub/stixfonts and https://github.com/fontsource/fontsource
Original unmodified font binaries. License files included.
Math font covers 4605 codepoints and has an OpenType MATH table; no Latin-only CSS restriction is applied.
Text files include Vietnamese, Latin and Latin extended subsets, weights 400/700.
